title: Posting the Resort Charge of a Resort Lodging Stay to Its Folio
content:
Where the resort charge a Resort Lodging stay owes falls due on the reservation, it is put onto that reservation's folio as one resort charge entry for the amount over the nights it covers, and the reservation's outstanding folio balance rises by that amount. The household sees a single resort charge line on the folio carrying the amount and the number of nights it covers, and the folio balance on the reservation goes up by the same amount.

## The act and how it is made

The act is the desk agent's own. The tool `post_stay_resort_charge_f79fa34a` is unlocked and then called by the agent, with the figure the agent has worked out from the collective's published terms and the records passed in; the tool writes what it is given.

## The parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `lodging_id` | the reference number identifying the Resort Lodging reservation whose folio the resort charge is posted to, read from the reservation record the lodging reservation lookup returns |
| `resort_charge_amount_usd` | the resort charge posted for the stay, in USD, as a decimal amount rounded to 2 decimal places; a value carrying more decimals is stored rounded to the cent |
| `nights_covered` | how many nights of the stay this resort charge entry covers, given as a whole number of nights with no fractions and no unit text |

## What comes back

A confirmation sentence on success, carrying the reference number of the folio entry created, the amount in USD posted, the number of nights the entry covers and the reservation's folio balance after the posting. Receiving that sentence, with a folio entry reference in it, is what indicates the entry has been written.
